neighbours.label: Words in a verb/preposition-object slot that refer to people or agents (them, someone, other members, its, a profession noun after 'about'), i.e. the point where a person-referent has just been named or is about to complete
fire: The coach never let the players down, and they stuck with her loyally; whenever a rookie struggled she would sit and talk to them for hours.
My grandmother always asked about the plumber whenever we visited, because she wanted to know more about him and his family.
When a nurse joins a new ward, the other staff will show her where everything is and look after her through the first month.
If you're worried about your friend, don't try to talk him out of the decision; just stay with someone who can listen.
Mira spent the afternoon thinking about electricians, wondering what the lives of those who rewire old houses were really like.
Bring a neighbor along to the meeting, and let the others introduce themselves before the vote begins.

def assign(task, worker):
    # Wait until the worker is idle, then hand it the job and let it
    # report back to the other workers when it finishes.
    worker.submit(task)
The manager asked how many of the staff she had hired, and which of the others still worked with her after the merger.
quiet: The coach never let the schedule slip, and she stuck with the plan carefully; whenever a drill struggled she would sit and rewrite it for hours.
My grandmother always asked about the weather whenever we visited, because she wanted to know more about the harvest and the fields.
When a printer joins a new network, the other settings will show where everything is and carry the firmware through the first update.
If you're worried about your budget, don't try to cut it down to nothing; just keep a spreadsheet that can track every cost.
Mira spent the afternoon thinking about thunderstorms, wondering what the pressure of those that roll across old plains was really like.
Bring a casserole along to the meeting, and let the lemonade cool before the vote begins.

def assign(task, queue):
    # Wait until the queue is empty, then push the job and let the
    # logger print the result when the loop finishes.
    queue.submit(task)
The warehouse listed how many of the boxes were shipped, and which of the pallets still sat in the loading bay after the storm.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, census arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + concept-census evidence (which concepts and domains selected the pole)); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong activations are a mix: object pronouns/determiners referring to people ('them', 'someone', 'other', 'its', 'her') after verbs like talk/stick with/cheat on, with census showing profession nouns in neutral 'about X' frames firing at 88%. Pole is broad (1% of tokens above 0.1 max) so near misses swap people for things at the same slot.
